import csv
import xlrd
from pathlib import Path
src = Path('inputs/pone.0150501.s002.xls')
out = Path('staging')
book = xlrd.open_workbook(src.as_posix(), on_demand=True)
sheet = book.sheet_by_name('RAW DATA')
header = [str(x).strip() for x in sheet.row_values(1)]
sample_ids = header[1:]
miRNA_ids = [str(sheet.cell_value(i, 0)).strip() for i in range(2, sheet.nrows)]

def cell_text(v):
    if isinstance(v, float):
        return repr(v)
    return str(v)

with (out/'data_matrix.tsv').open('w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
    w = csv.writer(fh, delimiter='\\t', lineterminator='\\n')
    w.writerow(['miRNA'] + sample_ids)
    for i, ident in enumerate(miRNA_ids, start=2):
        w.writerow([ident] + [cell_text(sheet.cell_value(i, j)) for j in range(1, sheet.ncols)])

with (out/'sample_metadata.tsv').open('w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
    w = csv.writer(fh, delimiter='\\t', lineterminator='\\n')
    w.writerow(['sample', 'Group'])
    for sid in sample_ids:
        w.writerow([sid, 'patient' if sid.startswith('P_') else 'control'])

with (out/'variable_metadata.tsv').open('w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
    w = csv.writer(fh, delimiter='\\t', lineterminator='\\n')
    w.writerow(['miRNA', 'miRNA_id'])
    for ident in miRNA_ids:
        w.writerow([ident, ident])

print('matrix_dimensions=%dx%d' % (len(miRNA_ids), len(sample_ids)))
for name in ('data_matrix.tsv','sample_metadata.tsv','variable_metadata.tsv'):
    p=out/name
    print(name, p.stat().st_size, 'bytes')
    with p.open(encoding='utf-8') as fh:
        for _ in range(3):
            line=fh.readline()
            if not line: break
            print(line.rstrip('\\n'))
PY"

bounded live BioContainers lookup. Use a bare tagged reference without
`docker://` or a digest.

```yaml
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: data
    format: tabular
    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```

For generated glue scripts, avoid nested `python -c` quoting. A base64 argument
keeps the script as one shell token:

```bash
SCRIPT_B64='BASE64_WITHOUT_NEWLINES'
python -c 'import base64, pathlib, sys; pathlib.Path("job.py").write_bytes(base64.b64decode(sys.argv[1]))' "$SCRIPT_B64"
python job.py "$(inputs.inpu

representation.name: miRNA Ct two-group t-test with Bonferroni and BY corrections
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > run_analysis.R <<'RS'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 4L) stop("Expected matrix, sample metadata, variable metadata, and alpha paths")
matrix_path <- args[[1L]]
sample_path <- args[[2L]]
variable_path <- args[[3L]]
alpha <- as.numeric(args[[4L]])
if (!is.finite(alpha) || alpha < 0 || alpha > 1) stop("alpha must be between 0 and 1")

expr <- read.delim(matrix_path, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE,
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("NA", ""))
sample_md <- read.delim(sample_path, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE,
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("NA", ""))
variable_md <- read.delim(variable_path, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE,
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("NA", ""))

if (ncol(expr) < 3L) stop("Expression matrix must contain an ID column and at least two samples")
if (ncol(sample_md) < 2L) stop("Sample metadata must contain an ID column and a Group column")
if (!"Group" %in% names(sample_md)) stop("Sample metadata must contain Group")
if (ncol(variable_md) < 1L) stop("Variable metadata must contain an ID column")

variable_ids <- as.character(expr[[1L]])
sample_ids <- names(expr)[-1L]
sample_id_col <- names(sample_md)[1L]
variable_id_col <- names(variable_md)[1L]
if (anyDuplicated(variable_ids)) stop("Duplicate miRNA identifiers")
if (anyDuplicated(sample_ids)) stop("Duplicate sample identifiers")
if (!identical(as.character(variable_md[[variable_id_col]]), variable_ids)) stop("Variable metadata IDs do not match expression rows")
sample_rows <- match(sample_ids, as.character(sample_md[[sample_id_col]]))
if (anyNA(sample_rows)) stop("Expression sample IDs missing from sample metadata")
groups <- as.character(sample_md$Group[sample_rows])
if (anyNA(groups) || any(!groups %in% c("patient", "control"))) stop("Unexpected group labels")
if (sum(groups == "patient") != 10L || sum(groups == "control") != 10L) stop("Expected 10 patient and 10 control samples")

p_values <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(expr)), function(i) {
    values <- as.numeric(expr[i, -1L, drop = TRUE])
    if (length(values) != length(groups) || any(!is.finite(values))) stop("Missing or non-finite Ct value")
    stats::t.test(values[groups == "patient"], values[groups == "control"],
                  alternative = "two.sided", var.equal = FALSE)$p.value
}, numeric(1L))

bonferroni <- stats::p.adjust(p_values, method = "bonferroni", n = length(p_values))
by <- stats::p.adjust(p_values, method = "BY", n = length(p_values))

bonferroni_out <- data.frame(
    miRNA = variable_ids,
    p_value = p_values,
    adjusted_p_value = bonferroni,
    significant_p_le_0_05 = bonferroni <= alpha,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
by_out <- data.frame(
    miRNA = variable_ids,
    p_value = p_values,
    adjusted_p_value = by,
    significant_p_le_0_05 = by <= alpha,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(bonferroni_out, file = "bonferroni_results.tsv", sep = "	",
            quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "NA")
write.table(by_out, file = "by_results.tsv", sep = "	",
            quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "NA")
RS
Rscript run_analysis.R "$(inputs.data_matrix.path)" "$(inputs.sample_metadata.path)" "$(inputs.variable_metadata.path)" "$(inputs.alpha)"

if (ncol(sample_md) < 2L) stop("Sample metadata must contain an ID column and a Group column")
if (!"Group" %in% names(sample_md)) stop("Sample metadata must contain Group")
if (ncol(variable_md) < 1L) stop("Variable metadata must contain an ID column")

variable_ids <- as.character(expr[[1L]])
sample_ids <- names(expr)[-1L]
sample_id_col <- names(sample_md)[1L]
variable_id_col <- names(variable_md)[1L]
if (anyDuplicated(variable_ids)) stop("Duplicate miRNA identifiers")
if (anyDuplicated(sample_ids)) stop("Duplicate sample identifiers")
if (!identical(as.character(variable_md[[variable_id_col]]), variable_ids)) stop("Variable metadata IDs do not match expression rows")
sample_rows <- match(sample_ids, as.character(sample_md[[sample_id_col]]))
if (anyNA(sample_rows)) stop("Expression sample IDs missing from sample metadata")
groups <- as.character(sample_md$Group[sample_rows])
if (anyNA(groups) || any(!groups %in% c("patient", "control"))) stop("Unexpected group labels")
if (sum(groups == "patient") != 10L || sum(groups == "control") != 10L) stop("Expected 10 patient and 10 control samples")

p_values <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(expr)), function(i) {
    values <- as.numeric(expr[i, -1L, drop = TRUE])
    if (length(values) != length(groups) || any(!is.finite(values))) stop("Missing or non-finite Ct value")
    stats::t.test(values[groups == "patient"], values[groups == "control"],
                  alternative = "two.sided", var.equal = FALSE)$p.value
}, numeric(1L))

bonferroni <- stats::p.adjust(p_values, method = "bonferroni", n = length(p_values))
by <- stats::p.adjust(p_values, method = "BY", n = length(p_values))

bonferroni_out <- data.frame(
    miRNA = variable_ids,
    p_value = p_values,
    adjusted_p_value = bonferroni,
    significant_p_le_0_05 = bonferroni <= alpha,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
by_out <- data.frame(
    miRNA = variable_ids,
    p_value = p_values,
    adjusted_p_value = by,
    significant_p_le_0_05 = by <= alpha,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(bonferroni_out, file = "bonferroni_results.tsv", sep = "	",
            quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "NA")
write.table(by_out, file = "by_results.tsv", sep = "	",
            quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "NA")
